question: The ________ is the central stretch of land between Western Ghats and the Arabian Sea in the Western Coast.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Kannad Plain**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• The Kannad Plain is located on the western coast of India, between the Western Ghats and the Arabian Sea.
 
• This plain is part of the larger Western Coastal Plains, which stretch from Gujarat in the north to Kerala in the south.
 
• The Western Coastal Plains are known for their fertile soil and significant agricultural activities.
 
• The Kannad Plain, in particular, is characterized by its flat terrain and is a prominent feature of the Karnataka coast.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Uttkal Plain:**

 
 
• The Uttkal Plain is located in the eastern part of India, in the state of Odisha.
 
• It is known for its rich cultural heritage and historical significance.
 
 
 
• **Rohilkhand Plain:**
 
 
• The Rohilkhand Plain is located in the northern part of India, primarily in the state of Uttar Pradesh.
 
• It is named after the Rohilla Pathans who settled in the region.
 
 
 
• **Barind Tract:**
 
 
• The Barind Tract is located in the eastern part of the Indian subcontinent, primarily in Bangladesh and parts of West Bengal, India.
 
• It is characterized by its older alluvial soil and is an important agricultural region.
